Yetunde in Abeokuta gives a free 1 kg of: Yetunde na Abeokuta na-enye onye ahịa ọ bụla wetara nke ọhụrụ otu kilogram otu n'efu, na-efu ya ihe dị ka puku naira 1,500. Ọhụrụ mgbe niile na-eweta ihe dị ka 1,200 nnukwu uru kwa izu, ya mere, ụgwọ ọrụ na-akwụ onwe ya n'ime ihe dị ka izu abụọ.
On WhatsApp Business, post clear dayligh: Na Azụmahịa WhatsApp, biputere foto nke ìhè ehihie na ọnụ ahịa, nkwụghachi ọhụrụ na ndụmọdụ bara uru. Nneka na Onitsha na-eziga mmelite ọkwa atọ kwa ụtụtụ.
Then ask every new customer how they hea: Mgbe ahụ jụọ onye ahịa ọhụrụ ọ bụla ka ha nụrụ gbasara gị, wee gbakọọ azịza ya. Tinyegharịa ihe na-arụ ọrụ. Ma kpachara anya na mbelata ego, nke na-esi na nnukwu uru na-abịa ozugbo.

Never share your bank PIN, OTP, BVN deta: Ekekọrịtala PIN ụlọ akụ gị, OTP, nkọwa BVN ma ọ bụ koodu WhatsApp, ọbụlagodi na onye na-ekwu na ha si n'ụlọ akụ gị. Gbanwuo nkwenye nzọụkwụ abụọ. Ma tinye ndị mmadụ na ndepụta mgbasa ozi naanị site na ikike ha.

Hauwa in Minna is offered a 200,000 nair: A na-enye Hauwa dị na Minna ego mbinye puku naira abụọ site n'ụlọ akụ microfinance iji zụta ngwaahịa n'oke. Ọmụrụ nwa dị pasentị ise dị larịị kwa ọnwa maka ọnwa isii.
5 percent of 200,000 is 10,000 naira a m: Pasent 5 nke 200,000 bụ 10,000 naira kwa ọnwa, ya mere 60,000 naira nke mmasị. A na-ewere ego nhazi nke pasentị abụọ, puku naira anọ, na mbido.
So the total cost of borrowing is 64,000: Ya mere ngụkọta ego a na-eri bụ puku naira iri isii na anọ, ihe dị ka puku naịra iri na asaa kwa ọnwa.
From her records, the bulk stock should: Site na ndekọ ya, nnukwu ngwaahịa kwesịrị ịtinye ihe dị ka puku naira iri na abụọ kwa ọnwa na uru net ya.
That leaves only about 1,300 naira a mon: Nke ahụ na-ahapụ naanị ihe dị ka puku naira 1,300 kwa ọnwa, ọnwa ji nwayọọ nwayọọ mee ka ọ ghọọ mfu. Ya mere, ọ na-echekwa ego site na nkwado ya ruo ọnwa atọ, wee gbazinye obere ego na ya na ọnụ ala dị ala.
Always get the total repayment in writin: Na-enweta ngụkọta nkwụghachi mgbe niile na ederede, wee lelee na ọ dabara uru gị kwa ọnwa.
Three warning signs: Akara ịdọ aka ná ntị atọ
Real grants never ask you to pay a fee t: Onyinye ezigbo ego anaghị arịọ gị ka ị kwụọ ụgwọ iji nweta ego ahụ.
Be wary of lenders who want your phone c: Kpachara anya maka ndị na-agbazinye ego chọrọ kọntaktị ekwentị gị. Lelee ndepụta akwadoro FCCPC.
Never share them. Check a lender is lice: Ekekọrịtala ha. Lelee onye na-agbazinye ego bụ Central Bank of Nigeria nyere ikike.
Watch for three warning signs. First, re: Lelee akara ịdọ aka ná ntị atọ. Nke mbụ, ezigbo onyinye anaghị agwa gị ka ị kwụọ ụgwọ nhazi ma ọ bụ ndebanye aha iji nweta ego.
Second, be wary of loan apps that want y: Nke abụọ, kpachara anya maka ngwa mbinye ego na-achọ kọntaktị ekwentị gị. Ụfọdụ kọntaktị ndị na-agbaziri eme ihe n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi. Lelee ndepụta FCCPC nke ndị na-agbazinye ego dijitalụ akwadoro.
Third, nobody genuine needs your BVN, PI: Nke atọ, ọ nweghị onye chọrọ BVN, PIN ma ọ bụ OTP gị n'ezie. Lelee na onye ọ bụla na-agbazinye ego bụ Central Bank of Nigeria nyere ikike.

For example, Comfort sells provisions in: Dịka ọmụmaatụ, Comfort na-ere ihe oriri na Calabar ma na-enweta uru net ₦80,000 kwa ọnwa.
Naira figures are illustrative and appro: Ọnụọgụgụ Naira bụ ihe atụ na ihe dị nso.
Here is a worked example. Comfort sells: Nke a bụ ọmụmaatụ ọrụ. Nkasi obi na-ere ihe oriri na Calabar ma na-erite uru ihe ruru puku naira iri asatọ kwa ọnwa. Ọ na-ekewa ya ụzọ atọ wee dee nkewa ahụ.
40,000 naira personal pay, 15,000 for he: 40,000 naira ugwo onwe, 15,000 maka nchekwa ya, na 25,000 dị ka ego uto.
Over three months, her growth money buys: N'ime ọnwa atọ, ego ọ na-eto eto zụtara puku naira iri asaa na ise n'ihe atọ ya kacha ngwa ngwa, n'ihi ya, ọ kwụsịrị ịgbapụ.
Customers ask for frozen chicken, so she: Ndị ahịa na-arịọ ọkụkọ kpọnwụrụ akpọnwụ, yabụ ọ na-azụta naanị ihe enyere ya iwu na WhatsApp. Ozugbo achọpụtara ihe achọrọ, ọ na-azụta friza nke abụọ, na-enweghị mbinye ego.
Best sellers often run out: Ndị na-ere ahịa kacha mma na-agwụkarị

You are ready to grow when you have made: Ị dị njikere itolite mgbe ị nwetara uru net maka ọnwa atọ ma ọ bụ isii n'usoro, ndị na-ere gị kacha mma na-agwụkarị, na ị nwere ebe nchekwa na ndekọ ọhụrụ.
As you grow, protect the business. Keep: Ka ị na-etolite, chebe azụmahịa ahụ. Debe ma ọ dịkarịa ala ndị na-ebubata ihe abụọ maka isi ihe gị, ekwela ka otu onye na-azụ ahịa buru ibu karịa ahịa gị, ma jikwaa kredit, n'ihi na ọ nwere ike igbapu ego gị ngwa ngwa.
